neighbours.label: pieces of all-caps words that the tokenizer splits into several tokens (shouted headings, banners, Cyrillic caps); the same words in lower or title case stay low

Our coach wrote on the board: CONGRATULATIONS GRADUATES, YOU EARNED IT.
The email subject line was UNBELIEVABLE OPPORTUNITIES WAITING FOR YOU.
Next month the club hosts the INTERNATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIPS in the old arena.
На двери висела табличка: ПРОДОЛЖЕНИЕ СЛЕДУЕТ.

The museum guide said ADVENTUROUS VISITORS SHOULD TRY THE TOWER.
The flyer added in bold: REFRESHMENTS PROVIDED AFTER THE CEREMONY.

notes: Card: peaks on 'Ю' in ДЕБЮТ, 'COM' in OVERCOMES, 'PRI' in SURPRISES, '.PRO' in PROPERTIES, 'OUR' in COURSES, 'CAM' in CAMERON, 'バイ'.
